microsoftLearnSources.title: Set Up General Fixed Assets Information

decision.reason: HGB is the smallest isolated setup layer after the cancel-safe Depreciation Book Card preflight. It does not require FA posting account mapping and does not post ledger entries.

targetAssessment.reason: Depreciation Book Card was opened cancel-safe; visible required setup appears narrow; depreciation book is a prerequisite setup layer before acquisition.
FA Posting Group Card has many G/L account fields. Account mapping must not be guessed from incomplete evidence.
Asset creation depends on depreciation book, posting group and acquisition path. Current evidence proves only an empty Fixed Asset Card.
Vendor flow reached only the template dialog. Downstream vendor card fields and posting/payment defaults are not mapped for this Fixed Assets purpose.

allowedNextRun.scope: Create or confirm exactly one depreciation book HGB in RM-DEMO via UI-first idempotent setup fit.
allowedActions: if missing, create Code HGB and Description HGB depreciation book
capture before and after UI evidence

bookImpact: Chapter 21 should treat the RM-DEMO Fixed Assets path as setup-first. The next practical setup step is HGB depreciation book only; asset, posting group, vendor, acquisition and depreciation remain later gates.
nextStep: Run FIXEDASSETS-014-HGB-DEPRECIATION-BOOK-FIT as exactly one idempotent UI-first setup fit, or stop if HGB cannot be created safely.
